name: Curve Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Curve Finance’s official website and X account were compromised in quick succession. On May 5, attackers first took control of the project’s X account and used it to post a phishing message promoting a fake airdrop. Then on May 12, the project issued a warning that the Curve frontend had been “hijacked,” in what appeared to be a domain takeover incident.
